items.source: count - if the provided count argument is positive, return a list of distinct fields, capped either at count or the set size. If count is negative, the behavior changes and the command is allowed to return the same value multiple times. In this case, the number of returned values is the absolute value of the specified count.
items.translation: count - 如果提供的 count 参数为正数，则返回一个去重字段列表，数量上限为 count 或集合大小中的较小值。如果 count 为负数，行为将发生变化，命令允许返回重复的值；此时，返回值的数量等于指定 count 的绝对值。
